items.event_time_ist: Wednesday morning, Oct 14 (reported 2:17 PM IST, Oct 14)
items.title: Houthis claim strikes on Aramco Dhahran, King Khalid airport and Riyadh refinery; pledge more operations
items.summary: Yemen's Houthis said on Wednesday they had targeted Saudi Aramco facilities in Dhahran, King Khalid International Airport and an Aramco refinery in Riyadh (Reuters, created 14:17 IST Oct 14), adding that their operations against airports and oil facilities would continue in the coming days. The claim follows Tuesday night's Dhahran office-tower hit (top three floors damaged, fire extinguished; Energy Ministry confirms, no casualties) and Tuesday's intercepts over Riyadh (debris wounded 4, damaged 15 homes). The Saudi side has not confirmed any Riyadh refinery damage. Regional outlets (Roya News English, ALGHAD.TV, DW Swahili) carried the same Wednesday Houthi statement as breaking news.
